business_summary: Weekly subscription service delivering fully prepared meals priced at $11-14 per meal, heating in 2 minutes. Targets busy professionals and fitness enthusiasts.
stated_claims: Fully prepared meals that go from fridge to plate in 2 minutes

relevant_tags.why: Core product category of prepared/ready-to-eat meals.
The business operates strictly on a weekly subscription model.
Meals go from fridge to plate in 2 minutes, targeting busy professionals.
Highly relevant to the targeted 'fitness folks' interested in health and nutrition.

note_signals.why: Swiftcart's convenience-seeking grocery buyers are an excellent fit for prepared meals.
Movewell's fitness-engaged audience directly matches the advertiser's 'fitness folks' target.
Studiogrid's self-care and fitness spenders align with the target market.
Kitchenly is a direct competitor selling meal kits on subscription.
Cloudfoot's urban professional audience perfectly matches the 'busy professionals' target.

gate_reason: The product, pricing, subscription model, and target audience are clearly defined and highly suitable for the network.
